REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM A2143/26 (200935 EUECYIYN MAY 2026).
AND TURKISH NOTAM REQUEST MESSAGE 250829 LTAAYNYX DEC 2025.
REF (B) GREEK COORDINATION MESSAGE 291240 LGACYAYC DEC 2025.
THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO STATE THAT THE REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM
A2143/26 (200935 EUECYIYN MAY 2026) IS NULL AND VOID SINCE IT REFERS
TO TURKISH MILITARY ACTIVITIES WITHIN ATHINAI FIR, WHERE THE ONLY
COMPETENT AUTHORITY TO PROMULGATE NOTAMS IN ACCORDANCE WITH ICAO
RULES AND REGULATIONS IS THE HELLENIC CAA THROUGH ITS APPROPRIATE
AIS UNIT AND THE ONLY RESPONSIBLE AUTHORITY FOR THE SAFETY OF THE
AIR TRAFFIC IS THE HELLENIC CAA THROUGH THE ATS UNITS.
AS HAS BEEN CONSISTENTLY NOTED IN THE PAST, AND WITH THE REF (B)
291240 LGACYAYC DEC 2025 GREEK COORDINATION MESSAGE TO TURKEY, PARTS
OF THE AREA MENTIONED IN TURKISH NOTAM A2143/26 (200935 EUECYIYN MAY
2026) OVERLAP AREAS OF NATIONAL SOVEREIGNTY OF GREECE.
FURTHERMORE, THE TURKISH REQUEST ENTAILS LONG-TERM RESERVATION
OF AIRSPACE CONTRARY TO THE RELEVANT ICAO RECOMMENDATIONS.
CONSEQUENTLY, THE AREA AS REQUESTED IS NOT AVAILABLE.
FOR THE ABOVE MENTIONED REASONS THE TURKISH NOTAM A2143/26 (200935 EU
ECYIYN MAY 2026) IS NULL AND VOID AND NOT APPLICABLE TO ATHINAI FIR.

GREEK AIR OPERATORS AND OWNERS OF ACFT REGISTERED IN GREECE SHALL 
NOT ENTER UIR KYIV (UKBU), FIR LVIV (UKLV), FIR KYIV (UKBV), FIR 
DNIPROPETROVSK (UKDV), FIR SIMFEROPOL (UKFV), FIR ODESA (UKOV), FIR 
ROSTOV (URRV), FIR CHISINAU (LUUU) EXCEPT FOR THE PORTION OF 
AIRSPACE DESCRIBED IN AND RELATED TO RELEVANT NOTAM AND AIP SUPS 
ISSUED BY REPUBLIC OF MOLDOVA.

WITHIN THE BUFFER ZONE EXTENDING OUT TO 200NM ALONG THE 
UKRAINE/RUSSIA BORDER.
ADDITIONAL RISK ASSESSMENT AND FLIGHT PLANNING DECISIONS SHALL BE 
TAKEN BEFORE OPERATING IN THE FOLLOWING AIRSPACE: MOSCOW (UUWV).

MILITARY INVASION OF UKRAINE BY RUSSIAN FEDERATION:
ALL RUSSIAN REGISTERED ACFT AND ACFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR
OPERATED BY NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSONS FROM THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION OR 
OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY THE 
RUSSIAN FEDERATION ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, LAND IN, TAKE-OFF FROM, 
OR OVERFLY GREEK NATIONAL AIRSPACE, EXCEPT HUMANITARIAN, MEDEVAC AND 
SAR FLIGHTS, OR ANY OTHER FLIGHT, AS IN CASE OF EMERGENCY LANDING OR 
EMERGENCY OVERFLIGHT, BY PERMISSION OF THE GOVERNMENT OF THE 
HELLENIC REPUBLIC. ALL ACFT OPERATORS OF NON-SCHEDULED FLIGHTS 
BETWEEN RUSSIA AND GREECE, OPERATED DIRECTLY OR VIA A THIRD COUNTRY, 
SHALL NOTIFY ALL RELEVANT INFORMATION CONCERNING THE FLIGHT,
AT LEAST 48 HOURS IN ADVANCE TO HELLENIC CIVIL AVIATION AUTHORITY
CONTACT: FLIGHTPERMISSION(AT)HCAA.GOV.GR.

NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM A3788/26 (261347 EUECYIYN AUG 2026).
AND TURKISH NOTAM REQUEST MESSAGE 191239 LTAAYNYX AUG 2026.
REF (B) GREEK COORDINATION MESSAGE 250940 LGACYAYC AUG 2026.
THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO STATE THAT THE REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM
A3788/26 (261347 EUECYIYN AUG 2026) IS NULL AND VOID SINCE IT REFERS
TO TURKISH MILITARY ACTIVITIES WITHIN ATHINAI FIR, WHERE THE ONLY
COMPETENT AUTHORITY TO PROMULGATE NOTAMS IN ACCORDANCE WITH ICAO
RULES AND REGULATIONS IS THE HELLENIC AVIATION SERVICE PROVIDER
(HASP) THROUGH ITS APPROPRIATE AIS UNIT AND THE ONLY RESPONSIBLE
AUTHORITY FOR THE SAFETY OF THE AIR TRAFFIC IN THE AREA IS THE
HELLENIC AVIATION SERVICE PROVIDER (HASP) THROUGH THE ATS AND ATC
UNITS.
MOREOVER, AS IT WAS NOTIFIED THROUGH THE REF (B) GREEK COORDINATION 
MESSAGE 250940 LGACYAYC AUG 2026, THE GREEK COMPETENT AUTHORITIES DID
NOT PROMULGATE A NOTAM IN RESPONSE TO REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM REQUEST 
GIVEN THAT PART OF THE AREA REQUESTED OVERLAPS AREA OF NATIONAL
SOVEREIGNTY OF GREECE. 
FOR ALL THE ABOVE MENTIONED REASONS THE REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM
A3788/26 (261347 EUECYIYN AUG 2026) IS NULL AND VOID AND NOT
APPLICABLE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR.

properties.originalText:
FIREFIGHTING ACTIVITY IS REGULATED AS FLW: 
-AIRCRAFT NOT INVOLVED IN FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS MUST NOT 
FLY OVER THE FIRE AREA AND MUST EXERCISE EXTREME CAUTION 
WHEN FLYING NEAR IT, CONSIDERING THE POSSIBLE INTERVENTION 
OF FIREFIGHTING ACFT. 
THEREFORE, WHEN AN AERIAL FIREFIGHTING OPERATION IS 
ANNOUNCED/ACTIVE, IT IS PROHIBITED TO FLY IN THE ZONES IDENTIFIED 
BY THE FIRE-FIGHTING AUTHORITIES AND NOTIFIED BY THE COMPETENT 
AUTHORITY OR, IN THE ABSENCE OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS: 
I. WITHIN CONTROLLED AIRSPACE, IN THE ABSENCE OF SPECIFIC 
COMMUNICATIONS ABOUT THE AREA AFFECTED BY THE FIREFIGHTING 
OPERATIONS FROM THE ENGAGED ACFT, BELOW 760M (2500FT) AGL 
WITHIN AN AREA EXTENDING UP TO A HORIZONTAL DISTANCE OF 4KM 
(2 NM) FROM THE FIRE 
II. OUTSIDE CONTROLLED AIRSPACE, BELOW 900M (3000FT) AGL, 
WITHIN AN AREA EXTENDING UP TO A HORIZONTAL DISTANCE OF 9KM 
(5NM) FROM THE FIRE. 
-TIMELY UPDATES REGARDING THE ZONES AND AREAS AFFECTED 
CAN BE BROADCAST ON GROUND/AIR/GROUND FREQUENCIES. 
-THE ENGAGED FIREFIGHTING AIRCRAFT KEEP THE ATS UNIT 
RESPONSIBLE FOR THE AFFECTED AREA INFORMED ABOUT THE 
FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS AND THEIR CONCLUSION. 
-THE ATS UNIT RESPONSIBLE FOR THE AREA AFFECTED BY THE 
FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS PROVIDES AIR TRAFFIC SERVICES, AS FAR 
AS POSSIBLE: 
1.TO THE AIRCRAFT ENGAGED IN FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS, EXCEPT 
IN THE FIREFIGHTING AREA WHERE IT PROVIDES ONLY FLIGHT INFORMATION 
AND ALERT SERVICES. 
RMK: IF A CTR IS AFFECTED BY THE FIRE, SID/STAR/INSTR APCH PROC COULD 
BE TEMPORARILY SUSPENDED OR MODIFIED 
2.TO OTHER GAT FLIGHTS, BASED ON THE INFORMATION AVAILABLE REGARDING 
THE FIREFIGHTING ACTIVITY, WHICH MAY STILL BE INCOMPLETE. 
REF AIP ENR 1.1.1.4 'POLICE, CUSTOMS AND PATROL FLIGHTS ENGAGED IN 
URGENCY MISSIONS', PARAGRAPH C 'FIREFIGHTING'

A) LIBB LIMM LIRR B) 2609171405 C) PERM E) FIREFIGHTING ACTIVITY IS REGULATED AS FLW: 
-AIRCRAFT NOT INVOLVED IN FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS MUST NOT 
FLY OVER THE FIRE AREA AND MUST EXERCISE EXTREME CAUTION 
WHEN FLYING NEAR IT, CONSIDERING THE POSSIBLE INTERVENTION 
OF FIREFIGHTING ACFT. 
THEREFORE, WHEN AN AERIAL FIREFIGHTING OPERATION IS 
ANNOUNCED/ACTIVE, IT IS PROHIBITED TO FLY IN THE ZONES IDENTIFIED 
BY THE FIRE-FIGHTING AUTHORITIES AND NOTIFIED BY THE COMPETENT 
AUTHORITY OR, IN THE ABSENCE OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS: 
I. WITHIN CONTROLLED AIRSPACE, IN THE ABSENCE OF SPECIFIC 
COMMUNICATIONS ABOUT THE AREA AFFECTED BY THE FIREFIGHTING 
OPERATIONS FROM THE ENGAGED ACFT, BELOW 760M (2500FT) AGL 
WITHIN AN AREA EXTENDING UP TO A HORIZONTAL DISTANCE OF 4KM 
(2 NM) FROM THE FIRE 
II. OUTSIDE CONTROLLED AIRSPACE, BELOW 900M (3000FT) AGL, 
WITHIN AN AREA EXTENDING UP TO A HORIZONTAL DISTANCE OF 9KM 
(5NM) FROM THE FIRE. 
-TIMELY UPDATES REGARDING THE ZONES AND AREAS AFFECTED 
CAN BE BROADCAST ON GROUND/AIR/GROUND FREQUENCIES. 
-THE ENGAGED FIREFIGHTING AIRCRAFT KEEP THE ATS UNIT 
RESPONSIBLE FOR THE AFFECTED AREA INFORMED ABOUT THE 
FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS AND THEIR CONCLUSION. 
-THE ATS UNIT RESPONSIBLE FOR THE AREA AFFECTED BY THE 
FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS PROVIDES AIR TRAFFIC SERVICES, AS FAR 
AS POSSIBLE: 
1.TO THE AIRCRAFT ENGAGED IN FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS, EXCEPT 
IN THE FIREFIGHTING AREA WHERE IT PROVIDES ONLY FLIGHT INFORMATION 
AND ALERT SERVICES. 
RMK: IF A CTR IS AFFECTED BY THE FIRE, SID/STAR/INSTR APCH PROC COULD 
BE TEMPORARILY SUSPENDED OR MODIFIED 
2.TO OTHER GAT FLIGHTS, BASED ON THE INFORMATION AVAILABLE REGARDING 
THE FIREFIGHTING ACTIVITY, WHICH MAY STILL BE INCOMPLETE. 
REF AIP ENR 1.1.1.4 'POLICE, CUSTOMS AND PATROL FLIGHTS ENGAGED IN 
URGENCY MISSIONS', PARAGRAPH C 'FIREFIGHTING'

INAI FIR AS WELL AS THE REF (C) GREEK NOTAM A3595/26, WHICH IS FULLY 
IN FORCE.

ATHINAI FIR AS DESCRIBED BELOW:

APPENDIX 4, PARA 1.6 AND ACCORDING TO AIP-GREECE, ENR 1.10 AND GEN
1.7-1.

properties.originalText:
NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
FURTHER TO GREEK NOTAM A3697/26 (061219 EUECYIYN OCT 2026) ON TURKISH
NAVY AND AIRFORCE EXERCISE AND REFERRING TO TURKISH NOTAM A4506/26  
(070729 EUECYIYN OCT 2026) WE STATE THE FOLLOWING:
- THE ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS MENTIONED IN PARAGRAPHS 4.2 AND 4.3
OF THE GREEK NOTAM A3697/26 AIM AT:
1. THE PROMOTION OF SAFETY, REGULARITY AND EFFICIENCY OF
INTERNATIONAL AIR NAVIGATION AND THE AVOIDANCE OF INTERCEPTION OF
EXERCISE AIRCRAFT FOR IDENTIFICATION PURPOSES IN CONFORMITY WITH
ARTICLE 3 (D) OF THE ICAO CONVENTION ON INTERNATIONAL CIVIL AVIATION
AS AMPLIFIED BY THE A40-04 ICAO ASSEMBLY RESOLUTIONS, APPENDIX I,
RESOLVING  CLAUSE 2, SEE ALSO THE ANNEX 2 TO THE ICAO CONVENTION ON
INTERNATIONAL CIVIL AVIATION AS WELL AS ARTICLE 12 OF THE ICAO
CONVENTION AND THE ESTABLISHED INTERNATIONAL PRACTICE.
2. THE PREVENTION OF ANY MISUNDERSTANDING WITH REGARD TO THE WIDTH
OF THE NATIONAL AIRSPACE OF GREECE.
THEREFORE, TURKISH NOTAM A4506/26 (070729 EUECYIYN OCT 2026)
IS CONSIDERED NULL AND VOID AND NOT APPLICABLE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR/
HELLAS UIR.
THE ONLY VALID NOTAM FOR THE TURKISH NAVY AND AIRFORCE EXERCISE
WITHIN ATHINAI FIR IS THE ABOVE MENTIONED A3697/26 NOTAM ISSUED BY 
GREECE.
